# Vitrification
The Vitrification Plant melts 1,000 mB of High-Level Liquid Waste with four glass blocks into a Vitrified Waste Log in a steel canister. Logs are radioactive and warm, and their activity halves every 30 in-game days.
# Geological Repository
A vault below Y -40, set in deepslate. It takes Vitrified Waste Logs and Dry Casks and stores them safely, showing what it holds.

# Low-level waste
Contaminated items, used hazmat pieces and used HEPA Filters go into the Waste Compactor with an empty Waste Drum, which comes out a Low-Level Waste Drum. Store drums anywhere shielded.
